feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 27 November 2026 10:30pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 27 November 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Cloudy through the night, perhaps with a few spots of drizzle on the hills. Light to moderate southeast winds gradually increasing fresh to strong. Minimum temperature 4°C.

Then a spell of rain arrives late morning Saturday, turning heavy at times through the afternoon, then clearing early evening with clear skies following. Fresh to strong southeast winds, veering west late afternoon, then easing later. Maximum temperature 10°C.

Comments: Strong winds. Yellow coastal overtopping warning at high tide (~13:45). Heavy rain in the afternoon.


##Outlook##

Clear/Sunny intervals for much of Sunday, though clouding over for a time during the morning with scattered showers. Cloud thickening again later ahead of a band of rain arriving overnight. Fresh to strong southwest winds. Maximum temperature 11°C.

Comments: Strong winds.

8:09am Tomorrow


##Sunset##
